Name: Trashing Makes Trash
Author: cardiacman
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Throwing things away makes trash! Discard an item or stack and get the same number of vanilla Trash. Upgraded trash cans still give their usual cash refund.
[/color]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Installation instructions[/color][/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the
[/color]
[code]TrashingMakesTrash[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder in your Stardew Valley
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Main features[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]One Trash for every item discarded.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Trash appears at your feet after you close the menu.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works with full backpacks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Keeps normal trash-can refunds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Discarding Trash produces nothing.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No configuration needed.[/color][/*]
[/list][heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requirements[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 or later[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI [b]4.4.0 or later[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]PC, Mac or Linux.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]In multiplayer, each player who wants the effect needs the mod installed.
[/color]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shout outs[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Harmony[/b] developers, and [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for Stardew Valley.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Trashing Makes Trash
